title: Smart Features

body.text: Smart Reply/Compose in Gmail, Smart Fill in Sheets, automatic summaries in Docs
— small things that together save hours per week.

example: "Smart Fill: type the split first/last name in the first 2 rows, and Sheets sees the pattern and fills the rest of the column"

title: Configure them to fit you

body.text: turn each one on/off in Settings, in both Gmail and Workspace
— some people like full help; for some work (like sensitive emails) you should turn it off and type every word. Choose what fits the context.

example: "The sales team enables Smart Compose fully / the legal team turns it off for contract emails, for word-level precision"

question: What does Smart Fill in Sheets do?

options.text: Sees the pattern from examples and fills in the rest

question: Can smart features be turned off?

options.text: Yes, adjust each feature in Settings
You must delete the account to turn them off

question: For what work might you turn off Smart Compose?

options.text: Sensitive emails where every word must be precise

question: To tune smart features to fit your privacy needs, what should you do?

options.text: Turn features on/off as needed in settings
AI features that assist work within Google services
